notes.title: The guardians of the system and its ultimate victims
notes.content:
In the cyberpunk Krakow of 2084, "Observers" are elite detectives of the future, whose work extends far beyond traditional investigative methods. Armed with the Dream Eater—a device capable of hacking minds—they penetrate the memories, emotions, and deepest fears of their suspects. Yet, their gift is also a curse.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/9fc0a3d78a2618e834aa941b48b53cb065a8b6f4.jpg[/img] 

The Dream Eater was meant to be a tool of justice, but it became a sentence—one that punishes both the guilty and those merely seeking truth. Every intrusion into another’s consciousness not only unveils dark secrets but also tears apart the boundaries between reality and nightmare. 

Daniel Lazarski, the game’s protagonist, is an Observer himself. As an agent of Chiron, the corporation that controls every aspect of life, he becomes a tool of the system. Interrogations no longer take place in closed rooms—Daniel dives directly into the minds of his targets, exploring the chaotic, surreal visions of their thoughts.  

Each journey through someone’s mind plunges the player into a claustrophobic atmosphere of fear, where the line between dream and reality becomes ever more blurred. “Observing” is a brutal process, often leading to the irreversible destruction of the psyche—both for those being hacked and for the Observer himself. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/fb82948a014bef6abad80051d7982b36b557a8ce.jpg[/img]

As the story progresses, Daniel gradually loses his grip on reality, and his own psyche begins to unravel. Is the Observer truly in control of other people’s minds, or is he the one being controlled? In a world where technology grants limitless power, are we still capable of holding on to our own identity? 

In this game, Observers symbolize the fear of technological enslavement. They are both the guardians of the system and its ultimate victims. What was meant to be a tool of justice has instead become a mechanism of dehumanization—a stark reminder that, in the cyberpunk future, control always comes at a price.  


Also be sure to  check a pulse-pounding, third-person survival horror with a gripping and twisted time travel story!

The game is coming to PC (Steam) and consoles in 2025!

notes.title: You're not in control. Never were. The corporation owns you!
notes.content:
[b]Daniel Lazarski is a quintessential cyberpunk character, burdened by the weight of technology and morality. Over the course of the game, his role as a relentless and terrifying Observer comes under strain.  [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/27592ac34b2d1501e60ec13bd5e490354e1fc324.jpg[/img]

The Dream Eater allows him to hack into minds via neural ports, dragging him into surreal, horrifying worlds crafted from emotions, memories, and traumas. You never know what to expect. One moment you’re wandering a corridor, and the next, voices whisper, and everything changes in a flash. You quickly reach a point where it's hard to tell what's real and what isn’t... Investigating someone else’s memories is a nightmare, and it always comes at a cost. Daniel gradually realizes that his life is as tightly controlled as the lives of the citizens he monitors. The corporate reality has turned him into a tool while stripping him of his own free will. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/9fc0a3d78a2618e834aa941b48b53cb065a8b6f4.jpg[/img]  

Chiron, the omnipresent corporation, embodies this horrifyingly dystopian vision of the future. It controls every aspect of life—from work and health to the safety of its citizens. It’s not just an institution; it’s a system of oppression that forces people into complete dependence. [b]As you delve deeper into the narrative of Observer: System Redux, you’ll uncover this grim truth as well. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/a56d18d8effacacbc3b5a4908dbbb6a756713a2e.jpg[/img]

Also be sure to  check a pulse-pounding, third-person survival horror with a gripping and twisted time travel story!

The game is coming to PC (Steam) and consoles in 2025!

notes.title: Polish themes in Observer: System Redux!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Observers! [/h3]

This week [i]Observer: System Redux[/i] is featured in the special [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/frompolandwithlove2024]Poland-themed Steam event[/url] with other games by our talented friends from our country. 

To celebrate this occasion, we've prepared a discount for our game. Be sure to take advantage of the deal if you plan to experience its dark cyberpunk story.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1386900/Observer_System_Redux/


What's more, we've prepared a number of facts related to Polish roots of our game so check it out below!

Here is the list of Polish references that you can find in the world of Observer! 

[hr][/hr]

[h3][b]The year is 2084...[/b][/h3]

The story of Observer: System Redux takes place in Kraków, Poland, in the year 2084.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/a56d18d8effacacbc3b5a4908dbbb6a756713a2e.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Retro-futuristic Poland[/b][/h3]

The game's world draws inspirations from Polish culture and the decor of the late 1980s. This  is reflected in the architecture, vehicles, technology, and items of everyday use. The world presented in Observer offers a true retro-futuristic depiction of Poland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/be811f35845ebc69bc8f7152172d9e1f1f962af8.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Protagonist's name[/b][/h3]

The main character's name, "Lazarski" has Polish roots, as surnames endings such as "–ski" or "–cki" are very common in Poland. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/9fc0a3d78a2618e834aa941b48b53cb065a8b6f4.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Same place, different story[/b][/h3]

The tenement, where the story unfolds, is a real location in the Old Town of Kraków, Poland. It is also the same place which is featured in another game by [b]Bloober Team[/b], [i]The Medium[/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/a1d7f98706a5f4c7097d5ff3bc1c102fb16217df.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Police car[/b][/h3]

The car belonging to the observer in the game, FSO "Polemos," is a fictional successor of the FSO "Polonez," produced in Poland. In 80 and 90s it was very often used as a police car. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/f874eb439e8dfe0aa02388f687b1e44bf2abed26.jpg[/img]


Until next one!

notes.title: Layers of Fear: the Series Crowning Work Is Coming out Next Month
notes.content:
Bloober Team's venture into horror began with the Layers series; the upcoming Layers of Fear will be the series' most important work and is scheduled to launch in June 2023. Developed in collaboration with Anshar Studios, it promises to deliver fresh gameplay, chapters, and a visually stunning experience. Here's a brief look at what awaits our dear players.

[h2]Game Content[/h2]

The series’ upcoming magnum opus is the definitive way to experience the critically acclaimed franchise as it features Layers of Fear and Layers of Fear 2, as well as all DLCs (including the new ‘The Final Note’ DLC that will give you a new perspective on the Layers of Fear storyline) and the never-before-told story of The Writer, which will tie everything together. Built on Unreal Engine 5, Layers of Fear supports Ray Tracing, HDR, and 4K resolution to make the stunning visuals, and your nightmarish experience, as immersive and realistic as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625995/7f5ba1257926ee64f62f35db18789fcffb8fffa1.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Preview[/h2]

Check out our latest 11-minute gameplay video and get ready to immerse yourself in the horrors that await new players and long-time fans of the Layers of Fear series. Witness the unveiling of the new mechanic, the lantern, and take a sneak peek at the gameplay in a new setting — inside a lighthouse.

[previewyoutube=hVioJM_lKwU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Next-Generation Graphics[/h2]

In addition to introducing brand new chapters and gameplay elements, Layers of Fear also demonstrates the impressive potential of Unreal Engine 5 - it's one of the very first games to date that were built with the newest technology. Take a look at the game's stunning graphics in a showcase video here.

[previewyoutube=iMkN8whZQmQ;full][/previewyoutube]

There's much more to learn about the game, go check out the Layers of Fear's Steam card for more information. Keep a close eye there as our developers host streams about the game from time to time.

Don't forget to share your comments and insights in the comment section of the news. Thanks for following!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946700/Layers_of_Fear/

notes.title: GET LOST IN THE WOODS. BLOOBER TEAM BRINGS FEAR TO PC VR
notes.content:
Bloober Team is excited to share Blair Witch: VR Edition is now available on Steam. Optimized for PC VR platforms, Blair Witch: VR Edition will be available on Steam for $29.99. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1576350/Blair_Witch_VR/

Blair Witch: VR Edition is an addition to the line-up of Blair Witch VR experiences previously only available on Oculus devices. The redesigned environments allow for more interactivity and accommodate new creature encounters. 

Watch the Blair Witch: VR Edition announcement trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W8kX1JOWUBM

Blair Witch: VR Edition is also now available on PSVR. Watch the Live-Action Trailer: https://youtu.be/EC3AqMjMeOQ

Features:
Improved Dog commands for Bullet:
● Pet Bullet to make sure he knows he's a good boy
● Change up his look with a variety of new collars
● Give Bullet treats. In the VR edition, he'll take them right from your hand
● Bullet can help you track scents through the forest, just give him an object to sniff
● Enjoy the company of your best buddy and shake his paw any time

Gameplay:
● Environments have been redesigned for more interactivity
○ Objects to catch, throw, or stack on top of each other
○ A marker to draw on paper and other objects
○ Drawers, doors, gates, and car trunk open at a touch
○ Breaking branches
○ Operation of mechanical elements: handles, buttons, opening locks with a key, padlock codes, etc...
● New control system
● New sounds and in-game events to surprise and scare the player.
● Additional creature encounters
● Unlockable Achievements and Trophies

Blair Witch: VR Edition is a story-driven psychological horror game from the creative minds behind the critically acclaimed Layers of Fear. Experience first-hand the toll that fear can take on the mind in an original story inspired by the cinematic lore of Blair Witch, designed for virtual reality.

The Blair Witch story has been rebuilt for PC head-mounted displays. With environments redesigned for more interactivity, new mechanics for your companion dog such as petting and fetching gestures, and additional creature encounters, you will experience the eerie atmosphere of the Black Hills Forest like never before. These cursed woods will awaken your darkest fears.

notes.title: Discover Dark Fracture, a new kind of psychological horror adventure
notes.content:
Our friends from Feardemic are proud to announce the next generation of terror: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268790/Dark_Fracture/?snr=2_groupannouncements_detail_]Dark Fracture[/url], a psychological first-person horror adventure game in which jump scares are the least concerning occurrences that the players will be facing.

The game is developed by the indie team Twisted II Studio and will be released in 2022 on PC, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch.

[h1][b]About the game[/b][/h1]
Set in the late 90s in a forested area of the Northeastern USA, Dark Fracture brings you into the eerie environment of a body farm – a decomposition research facility. You enter the world as Edward, a lonely individual tormented by a tragic past, whose only solace is in the medicine that helps him to get through the day. Edward is barely able to cope with his issues, which are only intensified by the solitude of his workplace. He puts on a brave front and dutifully wakes up for work every day. His routine serves as his only anchor, but deep inside, trouble is simmering...

If you want to get a taste of what awaits you in Dark Fracture, you can already try Dark Fracture: Prologue, the free introductory chapter of the game 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389160/Dark_Fracture_Prologue/
